title: Inventory accelerator operational authorities and actual runtime wiring
inspection_method: raw-source-required exact-tree inventory against the checked accelerator gitlink; package README/package-map/execution guides used as secondary navigation only

checked_authority.authority_class: checked implementation authority for this board
checked_authority.later_revisions_policy: intervening commits and superproject pin 485edc08… are candidate evidence only; they are not current operational authority

absent_package_at_checked_head.note: later trees may contain a semantic-state package; checked head has none and must not be assumed

rules: no lower domain package may import entrypoints
entrypoints cold-import may load only provider-free contracts
no long-lived flat re-export stubs at retired package-root paths
package_direction.semantic_truth_boundary: accelerator owns operational coordination only; datasets owns semantic index/state/capsules/proof obligations; accelerator references datasets roots by type and must not redefine them

classification_vocabulary.library_capability: landed module/class/API exists and is importable under the domain package; may be unit-tested and optionally composed by non-LGSWF callers
classification_vocabulary.configured_launch_wiring: constructed, passed, or invoked by the sealed configured-board path used for this board (scheduler config → configured_board_scheduler → multi_supervisor_runner → implementation_supervisor_entry → implementation_supervisor/daemon)
classification_vocabulary.composed_bundle_path: optional alternate composition (for example objectives.bundle_supervisor) that wires full LeaseCoordinator/ResourceScheduler; not the LGSWF configured-board launch path
classification_vocabulary.compatibility_shim: historical alias, lazy package-root re-export, legacy status spelling, empty facade slot, or MCP/facade surface that is not primary operational authority
classification_vocabulary.not_wired: library exists but configured-board launch does not construct or bind it

configured_launch_path.plan_note: matches sealed plan statement that the checked accelerator CLI does not yet wire PlanRevisionStore, LeaseCoordinator, or ResourceScheduler into configured-board daemon execution

goal.authority_role: objective lifecycle and evidence-backed goal completion
goal.configured_launch_detail: configured board disables objective goal completion reconcile/migration/janitor; goal completion projection helpers exist on implementation_supervisor_runner but are not the LGSWF bootstrap actuation path
goal.composed_bundle_path: bundle_supervisor can observe goal/task readiness with full lease/resource composition
compatibility_shims: legacy goal status spellings complete/completed/done normalize to verified_complete for readers; new writers use verified_complete
LEGACY_COMPLETED_GOAL_STATES retained for migration detection only
goal.completion_rule: task population completion does not complete a goal; verified_complete requires fresh tree-bound evidence

task.authority_role: stable task identity, board projection, and readiness protocol
interfaces: markdown and duckdb projections as lossless views, not plan authority
task.configured_launch_detail: configured board points --todo-path at docs/architecture/logic_governed_semantic_work_fabric.todo.md with task prefix LGSWF-; bootstrap_task_source is legacy-markdown-pending-plan-revision-r1
task.composed_bundle_path: DuckDB/dual sources and PlanRevision-backed dispatch available when callers bind them
compatibility_shims: Markdown board remains a projection; PlanRevisionStore is the intended plan authority after LGSWF-009 r1

plan_revision.authority_role: immutable plan ancestry, active plan pointer, and create/steer apply receipts
plan_revision.configured_launch_detail: ImplementationDaemon accepts optional plan_revision_store and defaults require_active_plan_revision only when a store or compiled plan is bound; configured_board_scheduler never constructs or passes PlanRevisionStore. Board still records base_plan_revision urn:lgswf:plan-revision:r000 as a bootstrap label only.
plan_revision.composed_bundle_path: PlanSupervisorService and dual task sources can bind PlanRevisionStore when a program composes them
compatibility_shims: legacy markdown taskboard used as bootstrap task source until accepted PlanRevision r1

conflict.authority_role: which ready tasks may execute together; orthogonal to dependency readiness
interfaces: conflict surface prediction and explainable lane coloring
serializes to ordinary JSON for cross-process manifests
conflict.configured_launch_detail: todo_daemon does not import conflict_graph; configured board relies on protected paths, lane sharding, and file claims rather than constructing TaskConflictGraph
conflict.composed_bundle_path: bundle_optimizer consumes TaskConflictGraph for antichain selection in the composed bundle path

resource.authority_role: host/provider/pool capacity admission and fair backpressure
interfaces: capacity drift and compiled execution assignment helpers
resource.configured_launch_detail: configured board does not construct ResourceScheduler. ImplementationDaemon imports admit_compiled_execution_assignments and evaluate_capacity_drift helpers and uses file-backed implementation_resource_claim locks; that is not the full ResourceScheduler acquire/lease path described for the composed bundle supervisor.
resource.composed_bundle_path: objectives.bundle_supervisor constructs ResourceScheduler(policy) and reaps with LeaseCoordinator
compatibility_shims: RouteAwareResourceScheduler and FormalVerificationResourceScheduler are aliases of GoalRuntimeResourceScheduler

proof.authority_role: proof orchestration and formal-verification cache as consumers of datasets obligations; not semantic truth authority
proof.configured_launch_detail: ImplementationDaemon accepts optional proof_gate/proof_workflow/formal_verification_policy and proof_scheduler options keys, but configured-board launch does not bind a ProofScheduler instance. For LGSWF-003 inventory scope no datasets proof obligations are selected.
proof.composed_bundle_path: available when a program injects proof workflow options or uses proof package entrypoints directly
proof.authority_boundary: accelerator orchestrates proof; datasets owns obligation identity and formal VC/proof artifact kinds

claim.authority_role: ownership of work units and code-level claim records; multiple claim families exist and must not be conflated

families.configured_launch_detail: DuckDB LeaseCoordinator is the durable claim/fence authority on the composed path; configured-board multi_supervisor_runner does not construct it
primary claim mechanism on the LGSWF configured-board path: filesystem claim locks under the lane state directory, not LeaseCoordinator
assurance claim IR; not the task ownership claim used by the daemon
used when plan-runtime / active plan binding is enabled; not enabled by default on configured board without PlanRevisionStore

daemon.authority_role: implementation and supervisor process loops; claim, worktree, provider, validation, merge admission, status
interfaces: worker completion is not authoritative completion
generated runtime artifacts are not completion authority (scheduler config flag)
daemon.configured_launch_detail: this is the actual LGSWF actuation path after sealed preflight
daemon.composed_bundle_path: bundle_supervisor is an alternate multi-lane composition, not used by LGSWF configured-board common args
compatibility_shims: scripts/ops/agent_supervisor/* thin path-inserting wrappers around domain package mains

merge.authority_role: landing completed work onto the merge target; not task acceptance
merge.configured_launch_detail: configured board wires --merge-queue-dir and --merge-target-branch; ImplementationDaemon constructs MergeQueue. Full LeaseCoordinator-backed leased-lane composition is not used by configured board. Merge still does not imply AuthoritativeCompletionGate admission.
merge.composed_bundle_path: leased_lane + LeaseCoordinator + MergeTrain compose the full distributed landing path
compatibility_shims: integrations/llm_merge_resolver_fallback is an optional bridge, not merge authority

event.authority_role: append-only operational event stream, cursors, and recovery of JSONL logs
interfaces: JSONL event log with atomic append and cursor replay
large payloads offloaded via artifact_store / runtime_cas
event.configured_launch_detail: implementation_daemon and implementation_supervisor import and append/repair event log helpers for lane status and recovery

rescue.authority_role: bounded recovery, watchdog, quarantine, and authorized rescue actions
interfaces: watchdog liveness combining heartbeat age, lifecycle state, and process probes
rescue.configured_launch_detail: implementation_supervisor imports RescuePlanner and SupervisorWatchdog; configured board supplies stale_seconds, max_restarts, and watchdog_startup_grace_seconds. Full RescueOrchestrator control-transaction path is library capability used when a rescue plan is authorized, not continuous LGSWF bootstrap inventory actuation.
rescue.composed_bundle_path: available to any supervisor composition that injects rescue authorization boundaries

entrypoint.authority_role: highest-layer prompt-first composition boundary; cold-import contracts only by default
interfaces: DuckDB coordination vs Parquet/IPLD replication separation declared in contracts
entrypoint.configured_launch_detail: LGSWF launch uses runtime.configured_board_scheduler and todo_daemon implementation_supervisor entry scripts, not entrypoints LaunchPlan facades. ENTRYPOINT_LAZY_FACADE_EXPORTS is intentionally empty until facade delivery tasks land.
entrypoint.composed_bundle_path: resolvers and contracts are importable for future facades; lower packages must never import entrypoints
compatibility_shims: empty ENTRYPOINT_LAZY_FACADE_EXPORTS is an explicit non-facade state, not a runtime capability claim

wiring_matrix.notes: reconcile disabled on configured board common args
markdown todo path wired; plan-revision authority not yet active
TaskConflictGraph unused by todo_daemon configured path
ResourceScheduler class not constructed on configured board
ProofScheduler not bound by configured board
LeaseCoordinator not used by configured multi_supervisor path
filesystem task/resource claim locks are the live claim mechanism
MergeQueue wired; LeaseCoordinator-leased merge train not

compatibility_shims_and_facades.detail: __getattr__ resolves AGENT_SUPERVISOR_LANDED_MODULE_TO_PACKAGE stems and historical export names; import success is not a capability signal
AGENT_SUPERVISOR_G0xx_* and AGENT_SUPERVISOR_EVIDENCE_CLUSTER_* spellings remain as aliases of semantic layout names
complete/completed/done normalize to verified_complete for readers
thin sys.path bootstrap wrappers; domain package modules own behavior
ENTRYPOINT_LAZY_FACADE_EXPORTS is empty; not a configured launch surface for LGSWF
MCP unification plan treats these as compatibility facades/shims outside agent_supervisor operational authorities; not LGSWF coordination authority
source_binding.bootstrap_task_source = legacy-markdown-pending-plan-revision-r1; accepted PlanRevisionStore projection supersedes after LGSWF-009

control.role: transport-neutral control ops and permits; not the configured-board implementation loop

validation.role: pre/post merge deterministic gates used by ImplementationDaemon

authoritative_completion.role: separates merge landing from board acceptance; completion_authoritative cannot be self-asserted on ImplementationReceipt

product_gate_summary.present_qualification: no-go for continuous multi-supervisor fabric operation; bounded bootstrap inventories only
configured_board_actually_uses: filesystem task and resource claim locks
product_gate_summary.mutation_admission_gate: LGSWF-009 verified canonical roots and accepted PlanRevision r1

proof_selection.reason: LGSWF-003 is a read-only inventory of accelerator operational sources under raw-source-required bootstrap bindings; no datasets proof obligations are selected for this task
limitations: canonical semantic-state root unavailable at bootstrap
formal proof against symbol/capsule graphs cannot be current without LGSWF-009 roots
simulated or model-claimed proof is non-authoritative
Inventory is exact-tree raw-source observation at ea11293b; later superproject pin content is not current authority
No agent_supervisor/semantic_state package exists at the checked head

Configured-board wiring was determined from configured_board_scheduler, multi_supervisor_runner, implementation_supervisor_entry, implementation_supervisor, and implementation_daemon source, not from a live process dump
MCP compatibility facades are recorded only to prevent confusion with operational authorities
